messages.author: b3aa25fba15c5ba2
messages.subject: Polychoric instrumental variable estimator?
parts:
Hi!  I've been using lavaan since the winter of '13, but I'm new to the discussion group, so please set me straight if I'm overlooking anything important here.

Question/suggestion:
Is there any interest in developing support in lavaan for Bollen and Maydeu-Olivares' (2007) polychoric instrumental variable estimator for categorical SEM?

Sales pitch:
Apparently it's simple, just as effective as DWLS or ULS with properly specified models, and less biased than ULS in the presence of model misspecification (loadings incorrectly constrained to zero in their simulation).

Thanks for any feedback!

-Nick Stauner
Postdoctoral scholar
Case Western Reserve University

Reference:
Bollen, K. A., & Maydeu-Olivares, A. (2007). A polychoric instrumental variable (PIV) estimator for structural equation models with categorical variables. Psychometrika, 72(3), 309–326.  Retrieved from http://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11336-007-9006-3.pdf.

messages.author: b3aa25fba15c5ba2
messages.subject: Re: Polychoric instrumental variable estimator?
parts: Thanks Stas.  That does seem to be the same estimator, and the simulation study supports my sales pitch.  So, any interest in having this estimator available in lavaan?  The R code in that article looks like it's geared toward running the author's simulation with a specific model.  Given the merits of polychoric instrumental variable estimation, it might benefit a lot of SEM users like myself to have more flexible code for user-specified models.  Needless to say, having access to this estimation algorithm within the lavaan framework would be especially convenient!  I can't be alone in thinking so, can I?
